name: svg-grab-pro
description: Browser extension for Chrome and Firefox: grab any SVG from any website

scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run package && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.verify:bundle: npm run build && git diff --exit-code contentScript.js background.js popup.js
scripts.firefox: npm run package && web-ext run --source-dir dist/extension --target firefox-desktop
